description: A ground-level photograph depicts a multi-level road network within an urban or peri-urban environment. In the mid-ground, a prominent elevated highway structure carries vehicles, including cars and white vans, across multiple lanes. Below this elevated section, a lower-level road is visible with parked cars and a large white and blue bus in the foreground. A small purple circular marker is present on this lower road surface. To the left of the road network, a dark-facade building stands, with a taller, slender grey high-rise building further in the background against a clear blue sky. On the right, a large, tall grey building with numerous windows occupies the frame's right side; green foliage is visible at its base. Streetlights are visible along the elevated road. The image illustrates components typically classified as "Road networks and associated land" in Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) documentation, such as those found in Urban Atlas data or relevant to the definition of transport infrastructure for land cover classification.
